sources.snippet: Here we introduce AlphaEarth Foundations, an embedding field model yielding a highly general, geospatial representation that assimilates spatial, temporal, and measurement contexts across multiple sources, enabling accurate and efficient production of maps and monitoring systems from local to global scales.

sources.title: AlphaEarth Foundations helps map our planet in unprecedented detail
sources.snippet: Today we are introducing AlphaEarth Foundations, an artificial intelligence (AI) model that acts as a virtual satellite. It accurately and efficiently characterizes all of the planet's land and coastal waters, integrating immense amounts of Earth observation data into a unified digital representation, or "embedding," that computer systems can easily process.
